class.name: PBFParticleFluid3D
class.brief_description: Experimental native CPU particle fluid with position-based density constraints.
class.description: Simulates up to 2048 particles using Position Based Fluids (PBF): a compactly supported SPH kernel, iterative density constraints, deterministic sorted-cell neighbor lookup, artificial pressure and optional XSPH velocity smoothing. Unlike static fluid-plane buoyancy, particles move independently and can form a deforming free surface. Particle positions, velocities, box bounds, gravity and impulses are all in this node's [b]local coordinate system[/b]. The node does not create a visible mesh: render particles yourself with [MultiMeshInstance3D], a custom shader or a fluid surface renderer. See the Cgame Physics Lab sample for GPU-instanced sphere visualization. [b]Experimental:[/b] This is a bounded CPU demonstration of PBF, not a fully incompressible Navier-Stokes solver. The density constraint is one-sided (it prevents compression rather than forcing dilute free surfaces to expand). It does not implement viscosity between fluid and rigid bodies, surface reconstruction, GPU compute, two-way rigid-body impulses or thermal/multiphase effects. [b]Note:[/b] By default [member simulation_enabled] and [member collide_with_bodies] are [code]false[/code], so the class does no per-frame work. For manual stepping, use [method step] while simulation is disabled. The internal simulation tick runs in the regular physics frame. Parameters are intentionally capped to protect memory, runtime cost and numerical stability.

method.name: add_velocity_pulse
method.description: Adds a bounded, smooth radial impulse to particle velocities. Returns the number of affected particles. This is a velocity change, not a conserved Newton-second impulse, so it is intended for scripted stirring or splashes.

method.name: clear_particles
method.description: Clears the fluid's particle state and reusable neighbor-grid storage.

method.name: create_block
method.description: Creates a regularly spaced local-coordinate cuboid of liquid particles with zero initial velocities. The result is clamped to [member box_min] and [member box_max]. Returns [code]false[/code] without changing the previous particle state on invalid arguments or when the total count exceeds 2048.

method.name: get_average_density
method.description: Returns the mean SPH density measured in the latest PBF constraint pass. Zero before the first successful simulation step.

method.name: get_last_neighbor_evaluations
method.description: Returns the bounded number of neighbor interactions in the most recent substep. Useful for performance profiling; a particle can visit at most 128 neighbors during each solver iteration.

method.name: get_particle_count
method.description: Returns the number of live fluid particles (maximum 2048).

method.name: get_particle_positions
method.description: Returns a copy of the local-coordinate particle positions. Intended for rendering or inspection; avoid calling repeatedly for large batches.

method.name: get_particle_velocities
method.description: Returns a copy of the local-coordinate particle velocities.

method.name: set_particle_positions
method.description: Replaces all particles with these local positions and zero velocities, allocating reusable simulation buffers once. Rejects more than 2048 particles, nonfinite values, or out-of-range coordinates without mutating the current fluid state.

method.name: step
method.description: Advances the native fluid solver manually for [param delta] seconds. The step subdivides into at most eight segments of at most 1/60 second each. Returns [code]false[/code] for invalid or too-large timesteps. Do not also call this method while [member simulation_enabled] is enabled unless intentionally advancing the fluid twice.
